description: This PHP source file appears to be a script that manages the viewing of requirement revisions within a test management or requirements management system. It initializes page settings, checks user permissions, loads relevant requirement data based on node type (revision or version), and renders a Smarty template for display.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and retrieves request arguments, including item ID, project ID and name, and user ID.

methods.name: initialize_gui
methods.description: Sets up the GUI context, retrieves requirement version or revision information, and prepares data for display.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Checks if the current user has the necessary rights to view the requirement revision.
